### Epicurus on desire

Epicurus (341–270 BCE) approaches desire within Epicureanism. Pleasure is the beginning and end of the blessed life—chiefly absence of bodily pain and mental disturbance, not endless luxury. Natural and necessary desires are few; empty desires breed anxiety. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets desire most directly—useful for searches such as “epicurus quotes on desire.”
